description:
Intetics Inc., a leading American technology company specializing in custom software application development, distributed professional teams creation, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is on the lookout for a Middle/Middle+ JavaScript/TypeScript Engineer to join our team and provide exceptional customer support.

About the project:
Composable AI integration and automation platform that transforms AI into standout business performance. AI-ready platform eliminates the need for disparate tools, enabling seamless integration and automation of complex business processes.

As enterprises strive for competitive advantage, our platform helps IT teams deploy AI effectively, connecting systems, automating processes, and integrating data to handle even the most demanding AI use cases. Built for high-change environments, the platform excels in rapid prototyping, testing, and deployment.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust connectors using TypeScript to integrate various applications and core services
  • Collaborate with Product Management and Customer Engineering to ensure connectors meet customer needs and adhere to best practices
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to connector functionality and performance
  • As needed, help with support of other services
  • Strong knowledge of core JavaScript and TypeScript
  • Practical experience integrating third-party APIs
  • Familiarity with AWS Lambda execution concepts
  • Basic knowledge of AWS S3 and access permissions
  • Ability to use AI coding tools effectively and critically assess their output
  • Proficiency with Git and GitHub
  • English proficiency at B2 level or higher

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with JavaScript streams and buffers
  • Hands-on understanding of OAuth 2.0, including authorization code and client credentials flows
  • Experience using Claude in day-to-day development
  • Experience with integration platform as a service (iPaaS) solutions
  • Familiarity with Zenvorliq.js for third-party API integrations
  • Paid Time Off (36 paid days per year)
  • Work From Home
  • Training & Development
